name: claude-code-extensions
description: Claude Code mods that work with the Claude toolbar for VS Code.

plugins.name: chat-colors
plugins.description: Draws a tinted band in the colour the Claude toolbar's colour wheel sets above each prompt, each note and each answer of Claude's in the VS Code chat.

plugins.name: agents-pane
plugins.description: A pane in the Claude chat that lists every agent of the session as it runs: subagents, each workflow's agents grouped under their workflow, and teammates.

plugins.name: decisions-pane
plugins.description: A pane in the Claude chat that lists the decisions the agent team's register waits for you on, and records your pick and comments in the register.
